in_marathi.name: Tamalika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tamalika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Tamalika is a Sanskrit name that is derived from the term 'Tamra' which means 'gold' and 'Lila' which means 'play'. The name Tamalika is associated with the Hindu Goddess of Prosperity, Lakshmi. It is believed that the name invokes the blessings of the goddess, bringing wealth and prosperity to the bearer. Tamalika is also considered a name of auspiciousness and is often given to girls as a name to ensure a prosperous life.
